sources.label: Patches for some apps I use myself.
sources.author: jzl1
patch_list: Adds the stock QTRUN-signed configuration.xml and skips the native config-integrity mismatch gate, so the app can start without a fresh /cgi/report response.
Marks AdvancedActivity as exported for adb-based license-state verification. Disabled by default; not needed for normal use.
Unlocks all Ultimate features and makes the app usable on a clean install by bundling a signed config and bypassing the native config-integrity gate.
